notes_for_editor: Mostly three secondary sources; the 1910 keepers' table was matched by column position in OCR (Pino, 6 Feb 1897). Sources disagree on a 1914 move (Heritage register and PEI Society yes; Lighthouse Friends silent) and on the builder. Record shows built 1899 / 1876 and 'Iso Y 10s' in Wikipedia vs Fl W 5s; PEI Society says 'ISO Yellow, 5s on 5s off'. Not verified: final outcome of 2012 ownership petition. Page numbers for the 1922 report taken from scan page only. Wikipedia used for leads only. Sources disagree on when the old tower was declared surplus (Friends: 1973; Society: 1974-75); the story states both. 1910 table: name and date read from the same OCR line (printed p. 253). MacNeill/Walsh are range-light-era keepers named by the Society and Friends without a source of their own.
